text:
```yaml
name: Java Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'java/**'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        jdk-version: [8]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up JDK ${{ matrix.jdk-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-java@v2
      with:
        java-version: ${{ matrix.jdk-version }}
        distribution: 'temurin'

    - name: Update .gitignore
      run: echo "GSDK_output_*.txt" >> .gitignore

    - name: Build and test
      run: ./gradlew :gameserverSDK:test --info
```
